title: Margaret's Concerning Afternoon
description: A series of events that trigger the care monitoring system

events.narrator: Margaret mentions feeling dizzy while in the living room
Motion sensors detect unusual stillness - Margaret hasn't moved much
Heart rate elevated, blood pressure dropping - concerning signs

data.text: I think I need to sit down, I'm not feeling well

events.narrator: Still no movement toward kitchen - missed her usual snack time
Vitals slightly improved but still concerning

data.text: I'm okay, just need to rest

events.narrator: Margaret tries to reassure, but pattern is concerning
AI Agent analyzes accumulated data from last 10 minutes

data.reasoning: Multiple concerning signals: elevated HR, low BP, expressed dizziness, unusual inactivity. Pattern suggests possible hypotensive episode.

events.narrator: Agent decides to contact Margaret's daughter Sarah

arguments.reason: Multiple health concerns detected: dizziness, low blood pressure, elevated heart rate, unusual inactivity

events.narrator: System contacts Sarah with situation summary

arguments.message: Potential hypotensive episode detected. Margaret expressed dizziness, vitals show low BP (100/62), elevated HR (88). Currently resting in living room.

data.result: Alert sent to care team dashboard

data.outcome: Sarah calls Margaret, confirms she's feeling better after resting. Plans to visit this evening to check on her. Doctor appointment scheduled for tomorrow.

events.narrator: Situation resolved - early detection prevented potential emergency
